title: bhote topic
description: One topic as printed by `bhote show --json`, `bhote list --json` (array items) and every changing command with --json. A value that is not set is null.

id.description: Stable id, <created epoch>-<random>. Never changes, also not across machines.

n.description: Position in `bhote list --all` at the moment of the call. Usable as <ref> right away; changes when topics change.

waiting_for.description: Who the topic waits for; only set while status is waiting.

waiting_since.description: Unix time (seconds) since when it waits; only set while status is waiting.

agent.description: The herdr agent the topic belongs to (handed over with s, or the agent that last changed it), or null.

machine.description: Machine label (HOST_LABEL or a saved herdr machine).

session.description: The agent's session id (herdr agent_session, = CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID). Stable across herdr restarts.

branch.description: The git branch the agent works on ("@1234abc" when detached), read by the machine it runs on (GITHUB_BRANCHES).

slack.description: A pinned Slack channel, DM or thread: watched while the topic waits (SLACK_WATCH); a message from someone else sets it to review. null: none.

channel.description: Channel id (C…, G…, D…) or a user id for the DM

thread.description: Thread ts, when a thread is watched

message.description: The last message from someone else (who: text), while in review

updated.description: Unix time (seconds) of the last change; the newer one wins when replicas are merged.
